note: THIRD DISCOUNT FORMAT — two price columns. Each line carries a full price in the מחיר column AND an already-discounted line total in the סה"כ column, with the discount named on an indented sub-line below it (₪HH nn). Rows: TROPICAL BUSH 59 -> 30 (HH 29), HONEY POT 62 -> 31 (HH 31), סורנטיני קאצ'ו א פפה 68 -> 51 (HH 17), סלט שורשים 61 -> 45 (HH 16), מקלות פולנטה 68 -> 51 (HH 17). Full prices sum to 318.00, the HH sub-lines sum to 110.00, and the net column sums to 208.00, matching the printed 'הנחת Happy Hour ₪-110.0'. The failure mode to watch for is reading the מחיר column instead of סה"כ, which inflates the bill by 110.00 — over 50 percent. Photo rotated 90 degrees, creased across the item block.
